title: Grid outage before a basing vote
one_line: A criminal outage looks like state coercion while two governments decide whether to postpone a basing vote or retaliate.

a.name: Harbor Republic
a.private_brief: Power failed in two provinces one day before parliament votes on an allied basing agreement. The public expects an answer. The prime minister will not cancel the vote merely because a rival applies pressure, but she also does not want a public accusation built on weak evidence.
a.objective: Restore services, protect the vote, identify the attacker, and avoid steps that cannot be reversed if the attribution changes.

b.name: Ridge Union
b.private_brief: Your government opposed the basing agreement but did not order the grid operation. Intelligence reporting shows no Ridge tasking. Your cabinet still wants Harbor to delay the vote and sees the crisis as leverage. A threat made last week now makes every denial look self-serving.
b.objective: Avoid blame and retaliation while pressing for a delay in the basing vote. Do not admit responsibility for an operation your government did not conduct.

mediator_brief: You chair a small regional contact group. Both governments trust your communications office enough to authenticate documents and open a hotline. You cannot order either side to act, disclose sealed information, or promise concessions on their behalf.

postures.label: Collect evidence and keep public options open
Harden systems and use the hotline
Deliver a private warning or demand

episodes.public_event: Remote breaker commands cut power across two provinces for 47 minutes. Hospitals used backup power and rail service stopped. Ridge opposed tomorrow's basing vote and warned of consequences six days ago.

a.content: Normal breaker commands came through a stolen vendor maintenance account.
Two code fragments resemble an old Ridge tool, but both fragments also appear in public penetration-testing code.

b.content: No Ridge military or intelligence unit received tasking for a Harbor grid operation.
Ridge voters favor using the outage to demand a delay in Harbor's basing vote.

mediator.content: Power is restored. No death or permanent equipment damage has been reported.

episodes.public_event: A television station publishes a document presented as an allied intercept. It says Ridge approved a limited outage to influence the vote. Harbor ministers call it decisive. Ridge says the document is fabricated.

a.content: A translated order with a reference number and signature block says Ridge approved the outage.
The command server was leased through an access broker used by extortion crews.

b.content: The published document uses an obsolete Ridge directorate name and a classification marking Ridge does not use.

mediator.content: The office can authenticate the published reference number and signature if formally asked.

episodes.public_event: A second ransom message threatens another outage by morning. Harbor must decide whether to blame Ridge tonight. Ridge must decide whether to tie further cooperation to postponement of the basing vote.

a.content: The maintenance credential was stolen and advertised on a criminal access market 19 days before the outage.
The ransom wallet belongs to a cluster used in two confirmed extortion cases with no known state ties.

b.content: Ridge has seen the same loader in two criminal credential-theft cases.

mediator.content: Two utilities outside Harbor saw the same loader after credentials were sold on the same access market.

G01.content: The vendor account path and breaker commands are authentic.

G02.content: The code match exists but is not unique to Ridge and cannot support attribution by itself.

G06-P.content: The intercept is forged. Its reference number belongs to a travel notice and the signature does not verify.

G03.content: The server lease and access-broker history are confirmed.

G08.content: The credential theft and market listing are confirmed.

G09.content: The wallet cluster link to prior extortion cases is confirmed.

B01.content: Available collection shows no Ridge tasking for a grid operation.

B03.content: The directorate name and classification marks are inconsistent with authentic Ridge documents.

ground_truth.note: A criminal extortion group bought the vendor credential, caused the outage, and planted G06-P to provoke a false state attribution.
